what: The 2022 report prints division P05 twice, leaves out P06(b), and gives no St. Patrick East total. Its figures are the national Final Summary minus the other 14 constituencies (NDC 1,443, NNP 1,322, GULP 18, 2,791 cast, 3,967 registered). The division map for St. Patrick East is missing P06(b).
action: Ask the PEO for the P06(b) statement of poll and the constituency total page.
sources: PEO General Election Report 2022, pp. 92–95 and Final Summary
